name: MSA Type 2/3 (Gage R&R)
description: Measurement System Analysis Type 2 (with operator, Gage R&R) and Type 3 (no operator, automated measurement systems)
whenToUse: When a measurement system with several parts (and usually several appraisers) should be assessed: a crossed study gives repeatability and reproducibility (Gage R&R) by ANOVA; without an operator column the module computes as type 3 for automated measurement systems — not for the capability of a single gage on a standard, which type 1 covers. Requires parts, optionally appraisers, and the measurements as columns of a data collection.
operatorHint: Leave operator column empty for Type 3 (no operator influence)
warnFewReplicatesTyp3: Only 2 replicates per part — Bosch/VDA recommend at least 3 for Type 3 (e.g. 25×2 or 10×3).
chartGageRunTitle: Gage run chart (raw values by part and operator)
interpPass: Measurement system acceptable — measurement variation is small enough relative to the verdict basis (tolerance or study variation).
interpWarn: Conditionally acceptable — action recommended. Only acceptable for non-critical characteristics.
interpFail: Not acceptable — measurement system must not be used for inspection.
interpNdcPass: Adequate resolution — measurement system can distinguish enough categories.
interpNdcFail: Inadequate resolution — measurement system cannot sufficiently resolve part variation.
interactionPooledNote: The Part × Operator interaction was not significant (p ≥ α) and was pooled with repeatability.
errUnbalanced: Unbalanced design — every operator must measure every part the same number of times.
errUnbalancedTyp3: Unbalanced design — every part must be measured the same number of times.
errTooFewReplicates: At least 2 replicates per cell required (currently: {n}).
errUslLeqLsl: USL must be greater than LSL.
errHistSigmaInvalid: Historical process σ must be a positive number.
errCompute: Gage R&R could not be computed: {msg}

invariants.limitsOrder: LSL must be less than USL
